metadata.description: Signal yields for two min|y0| regions (hit-category specific). Hit category: isL2L2. Selections: psum in [1.5,3.0], hit-category, mass window |m_e+e- - m_V_D| < 1.7 * sigma(m_V_D), vtx_z > 5.0 mm, vtx_proj_sig < 3.9000000000000026, then min|y0| band. Regions: lo=(0.3599999999999999,0.6599999999999999), hi=(0.6599999999999999,inf). signal_regionX = S_yield.
